课程简介（中文）

　本课程旨在结合英语语言技能与基础医学知识，涵盖细胞生物学、胚胎学等领域。学生将通过真实文本学习医学知识和医学术语构词法。课程以语言学习为主，同时全面提升学生的医学英语技能，包括阅读（课本文本和课后信息搜索）、听力（视听材料）、口语（口头报告和课堂互动）和写作（学术写作任务），为学生提供综合语言训练。

课程简介（英文）

This course is designed to optimize the integration of English language skills with basic medical knowledge, covering key areas such as Cell Biology, Embryology, Physiology, Immunology, Pathology, and Microbiology. Students will engage with authentic medical texts to deepen their understanding of essential medical concepts while also learning the building blocks of medical terminology. Although the course emphasizes language development, it provides a comprehensive platform for students to appreciate the value of medical knowledge and its application.

 

教学目标

Throughout the course, students will enhance their English language skills in the following areas:

  • Reading: Engage with textbook materials and conduct independent research to expand comprehension and analytical skills.
  • Listening: Utilize audio-visual materials and related clips to improve listening comprehension and contextual understanding.
  • Speaking: Participate in oral presentations and interactive classroom activities to build confidence and communication skills.
  • Writing: Focus on academic writing assignments to develop structured and coherent writing abilities.

教学方式

The course encourages active participation and fosters a holistic learning environment that supports the development of values, knowledge, and abilities essential for both language proficiency and a foundational understanding of medical sciences.
